priceListMeta.title: PRICE LIST 2026 No. 71 gb, Version 02
priceListMeta.valid: Valid from 01.01.2026 until 31.12.2026 or until revoked for the UK
priceListMeta.pricesNote: Prices are in GBP include transport cost to the dealer's warehouse or DDP to the customer's address (kerbside) within mainland; recommended retail price GBP incl. VAT and shipping costs

coloursNote: Interior always grey white (price list p14). Web colour FAQ: metallic silver similar to DB 701, metallic quartz grey similar to DB 702, metallic dark grey similar to DB 703, grey white (interior) similar to RAL 9002; no RAL equivalents for the metallics. SKU colour prefix: silver 81/82, quartz grey 87/89, dark grey 85/86 (82/89/86 are used for standard-door 1D-4D and double-door C/D sizes).
sellingPoints: Modern design: Smooth wall surfaces and elegant acrylic glass panel in the door
Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers
Maintenance-free for life - 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort’s warranty terms and conditions
Comfortable door opening with gas spring
3-way locking mechanism complete with stainless steel door handle
Robust roof construction for a snow load of up to 150 kg/m²
Storm-proof up to wind force 12 (according to the Beaufort Scale: hurricane)* (* with professional assembly and anchoring)
Top quality materials: galvanised, polyamide enamel coated steel plate, screws and hinges made of stainless steel
guarantee: 20-year guarantee subject to Biohort’s warranty terms and conditions (product page); FAQ: 20-year guarantee against corrosion. Terms: www.biohort.com/terms-of-guarantee (price list p1).
delivery: Web: "Free Shipping within 3 weeks"; FAQ: stock products delivered within 3 weeks of order confirmation, free kerbside (road passable for a 38-tonne lorry). Price list p1: prices include transport to dealer's warehouse or DDP kerbside within mainland; stock items ready for dispatch within 2 to 4 working days after order clarification; address must be accessible for a 38 ton lorry (3 m minimum width of access).
steelThickness: No millimetre figure published for Neo. Product page: "Double the sheet steel thickness compared to low-cost providers". Comparison table: "Galvanised with protective zinc layer of at least 150 g/m² and polyamide enamel coating (same for all garden sheds)".
roof: Flat roof (product page heading "Modern Metal Garden Shed with Flat Roof"; comparison-table special feature for Neo: "Smooth side walls, glass panel in the door, wooden ceiling"). Wooden ceiling made of 19 mm plywood with a 1.5 mm EPDM roofing membrane (price list p14); exposed wooden ceiling inside, full-surface EPDM membrane thickness 1.5 mm (web). Roof pitch 1° (web FAQ table). Snow load 150 kg/m². Roof overhang 47 mm (web FAQ table). EPDM roof should be weighted with terrace tiles (30 x 30 x 2/3/4 cm); tiles per size in web FAQ: 1A/1B 12, 1C/1D 16, 2A/2B 15, 2C/2D 20, 3A/3B 21, 3C/3D 28, 4A/4B 27, 4C/4D 36; side canopy 2: 24, 3: 28, 4: 28.

web: 2 pcs. Shelves: galvanised steel plate, grey white coated, 56 x 26 x 17.3 cm (W x L x H)
Tool holder for the inside of the door (max. 4 per door): two pieces
Luminous element (lightly tinted) in the standard door

doors.notes: The standard door can be fitted on the side (web). FAQ: "The door opening cannot be changed on the Neo Garden Shed" (in answer to left-hinge question). Available on all 16 sizes.
From a width of 236 cm onwards (B, C, D widths) the double door can also be fitted on the side (web). Not available for A sizes (180 cm wide): no double-door SKUs for 1A-4A.

sideCanopy.notes: Optional side canopy can be attached from size 2A on the gutter side (web). Prices under accessories.

notes: 28 configurations (16 sizes with standard door, 12 sizes with double door) x 3 colours = 84 SKUs; every SKU has a JSON-LD GBP price on the GB page and the identical RRP in the GB price list.
Size code: digit = length step (1=180, 2=236, 3=292, 4=348 cm), letter = width step (A=180, B=236, C=292, D=348 cm) exterior incl. roof overhang.
Web data sheet weights are lower than the price list weights for every size; the price list states "The weights shown are gross weights".
The web data sheet table for 1C-4C and 1D-4D has no door-type heading; the EANs are listed under "With standard door" in the price list, so they are recorded as standard door.

Web "Matching accessories" for Neo are embedded in the product page HTML (per-SKU bundles). Items not offered there (floor panels, SmartBase, SmartBasePLUS, additional doors, side-canopy walls and glass, LED/solar light, PV mounting, BikeLift/BikeMax/BikeHolder, threshold ramp, 2- and 4-piece shelves, bin bag holder, tool holder) are priced from the price list only.
No GB Neo-specific price-list PDF exists; the GB price list is the full-range Endkundenpreisliste_gb.pdf (a guessed Neo-only URL returned 400).
Assembly time (web FAQ): Neo Garden Shed 6 to 12 hours (depending on size); HighLine/Neo Side Canopy 4 hours.
Neo bikes (web FAQ, 29in rims): side wall/back wall capacity per size published for 1C-4D; 1A none, 1B side wall 3-4, 2A side wall 3-4, 2B 5-6 both walls (second FAQ table).
